payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort array, then for each element compute x_i * (2^i - 2^{n-1-i}) mod M, summing over all subsets of max-min distances.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the coordinates to establish order, then uses index-based powers of 2 to calculate each element's net contribution as a maximum or minimum. This matches the combinatorial sum transformation after sorting.
